title: Cancel p50 as the book grows
subtitle: Median across 3 runs, resting orders spread over 100 price levels per side
caption: Indicative upper bounds from a heavily loaded machine, quantized to 41.7 ns ticks. The two indexes are indistinguishable while the book fits in cache. At 1M orders all three IdMap runs had a cancel p50 of 416 to 500 ns and all three std::unordered_map runs 750 to 792 ns.
